text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"The much-anticipated Air Groove and 
Silence Suzuka! With Air Groove's 
desperate final charge, Silence Suzuka has 
suffered a narrow defeat!"
(WOOOOOOOAAAHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Guh—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: (...Did I really win?)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
(Suzuka's running is still burned into my 
eyes— I can't stop trembling...!)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: (Besides—)

text_block_list.name: Male Fan
text_block_list.text:
"Suzukaaa!! That was so close!! But what 
an amazing run that was!!"

text_block_list.name: Female Fan
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka-chaaan!! Today's race moved me so 
much~~!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
(...The crowd is completely captivated by 
Suzuka's running. It's burned into their 
eyes as well, isn't it...)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
(That is how beautiful, free, and... 
dazzling Suzuka's running is.)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
(That is something... I understand better 
than anyone...)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: —Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Suzuka—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
It's my loss today. I couldn't catch up to 
you—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ……That's not right.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"I may have won the race, it's true. 
However—"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: My heart... has yielded to your running.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"After finishing the run, what lingers in 
this body is not the afterglow of 
victory."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
All I feel is fear and... 
"admiration"...!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I couldn't surpass you.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Air Groove—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ……! Pardon me, excuse me—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Ah—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Air Groove...

...Even though Air Groove had supposedly 
won against Silence Suzuka, her expression 
remained heavy.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...You understand as well, don't you? I 
could not surpass Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Even though I won, the image of Suzuka's 
run is still burned deeply into my 
heart...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...My trembling simply will not cease.

Seeing Air Groove's open frustration, as I 
searched for the right words to say—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Don't make a face like that.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"We'll be training again tomorrow. Calmly, 
just as we always do."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"As for the race we should aim for, for 
now, let's settle on the Sapporo Kinen."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...There, this should be more than 
enough. You have nothing left to worry 
about."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I'll be taking my leave ahead of you.

Air Groove ran off, leaving the scene 
behind.

It was the first time I had ever seen her 
look so frustrated and filled with regret—
